hypothesis: A fixed pair of whole-window solvers can preserve input fidelity across axial and high-flexion cases; choose by D-only pose, coverage and native-clock time quality. Never choose from R scores or window IDs.
candidate_origin: Both candidates pre-exist and are preserved; no fitting constants changed in this experiment.
selection: Missing observations then number of failed targets then worst and mean normalized P95; time step uses max positive per-step F-D excess. All D frames retained without R jump masks.
acceptance: Independent original-R native and export clock; selected and nonselected candidates both retained. Seven-window local evidence only; 20-panel/656 validation outstanding.
